title: 18.75-Inch Oval Combination Shower Basket | Unlacquered Brass | Baskets Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear up shower clutter and keep bottles within easy reach with an oval shower basket designed for organized, everyday storage in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story.

  • Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Designed for humid bathrooms: solid brass construction is designed to never rust.
  • Clean, finished look: concealed screw mounting system hides installation hardware.
  • Coordinated style: part of the Baskets collection—distinctive, transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 x 2.25 x 4.125 in.
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 24 x 8 x 8 in.
  • Shipping weight: 6 lbs
  • Mounting: wall mounted; concealed screw mounting system
  • Material: solid brass
  • multiple designer finish options available
  • Assembled in the U.S.A.
